mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the assumption that in the measurement of profit, costs should be set against the revenue that they generate at the time when they arise."
Matching Concept The matching concept/principle refers to the assumption that in the measurement of profit, costs should be set against the revenue that they generate at the time when they arise.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a legal entity whose operations and financial transactions are continuous in nature from one year to another."
A business is a legal entity whose operations and financial transactions are continuous in nature from one year to another.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of making the balance on the bank column of a cash book to agree with the balance on the bank statement received from the bank."
Bank reconciliation is the process of making the balance on the bank column of a cash book to agree with the balance on the bank statement received from the bank.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as a tangible or intangible resource that is owned or controlled by an accounting entity, and which is expected to generate future economic benefits."
An asset can be defined as a tangible or intangible resource that is owned or controlled by an accounting entity, and which is expected to generate future economic benefits.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the owner of Babafem Enterprises."
Babafidau Bim is the owner of Babafem Enterprises.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the assumption that an entity will continue in operational existence for the foreseeable future."
Going Concern Concept The going concern concept is the assumption that an entity will continue in operational existence for the foreseeable future.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the future and with future costs and revenues."
Decision-making is concerned with the future and with future costs and revenues.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a supplier to whom we owed a balance of N4,075 on March 1, 2012 March 2."
Favour is a supplier to whom we owed a balance of N4,075 on March 1, 2012 March 2.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the qualities that financial information should have, as detailed in the Framework."
Consistency is one of the qualities that financial information should have, as detailed in the Framework.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any item, process or activity for which a separate measurement of cost is required."
A cost object is any item, process or activity for which a separate measurement of cost is required.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statement (not an account) that contains the list of assets and liabilities with owner's capital at the end of a particular period, month or year, and arranged in an orderly manner."

Statement of financial position is a statement (not an account) that contains the list of assets and liabilities with owner's capital at the end of a particular period, month or year, and arranged in an orderly manner.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with making a choice between alternatives and frequently an important factor in making that choice is the financial implications of the various alternatives."
Decision making is concerned with making a choice between alternatives and frequently an important factor in making that choice is the financial implications of the various alternatives.
fib: ______ is described as 'on credit: The credit transaction with the storekeeper becomes a trade payable since he is now owes a debt of N30,000.
arrangement
The arrangement is described as 'on credit: The credit transaction with the storekeeper becomes a trade payable since he is now owes a debt of N30,000.
______ can be defined as a legal obligation to transfer assets or provide services to another entity that arises from some past transaction or event.
liability
A liability can be defined as a legal obligation to transfer assets or provide services to another entity that arises from some past transaction or event.
______ is a summary of customers or suppliers ledger in total.
Control account
Control account is a summary of customers or suppliers ledger in total.
______ is an expense to be charged against the profit for the year it occurred.
Bad debt
Bad debt is an expense to be charged against the profit for the year it occurred.
______ are those debts which in the opinion of management of an organisation may not be fully recovered.
Doubtful debts
Doubtful debts are those debts which in the opinion of management of an organisation may not be fully recovered.
______ refers to the keeping of accounting record by hand written of relevant posting in the books of accounts.
manual accounting system
The manual accounting system refers to the keeping of accounting record by hand written of relevant posting in the books of accounts.
______ is the procedure for accumulating data to provide information for managerial action.
Cost accounting
Cost accounting is the procedure for accumulating data to provide information for managerial action.
______ is the profit derived after all expenses and cost of sales have been deducted from the net income including sales of goods and other income.
Net profit
Net profit is the profit derived after all expenses and cost of sales have been deducted from the net income including sales of goods and other income.
______ is a list of ledger account balances within a ledger, at a particular instance.
trial balance
Definition of Trial Balance A trial balance is a list of ledger account balances within a ledger, at a particular instance.
______ is the analysis of the level of sales at which a company (or a project) would make zero profit.
Break-even analysis
Break-even analysis is the analysis of the level of sales at which a company (or a project) would make zero profit.
______ is a fundamental equation and is a valuable basis from which to begin understanding the whole process of accounting.
accounting equation
The accounting equation is a fundamental equation and is a valuable basis from which to begin understanding the whole process of accounting.
______ are the end points of books of accounts which are used to determine the income, profit, loss, assets and liabilities of a business concern.
final accounts
The final accounts are the end points of books of accounts which are used to determine the income, profit, loss, assets and liabilities of a business concern.
